actions.label: Reproduce Updating Nvidia drivers breaks FancyZones

prerequisites: Use the reported configuration for FancyZones.
steps: Have PowerToys running in the system tray.
Using Nvidia's GeForce Experience, use the Express Installation to update drivers (I updated to version 516.94).
I was not instructed to restart my device afterward.
Now, attempt to drag a window into a selected zone while pressing shift.
FancyZones should no longer be functioning, despite PowerToys still running in the system Tray.
reproduce.expected_result: The window should snap into place when pressing shift.

judgment.rationale: The public report contains a concrete scenario and expected-versus-actual behavior, but the current evidence does not yet establish a safe implementation change.
evidence: The report covers PowerToys 0.61.1, affecting FancyZones.

Reported reproduction: Have PowerToys running in the system tray. Using Nvidia's GeForce Experience, use the Express Installation to update drivers (I updated to version 516.94). I was not instructed to restart my device afterward. Now, attempt to drag a window into a selected zone while pressing shift. FancyZones should no longer be functioning, despite PowerToys still running in the system Tray.

Reported result: The FancyZones UI did not show up and windows would not snap. Upon restarting PowerToys, the customized zones had reset to their defaults instead the ones I had selected before updating the drivers.
